propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds an active CAMS certification, awarded in November 2021 and checked on the ACAMS certification directory.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certification and member ID and the recruiter verification records the directory check.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has seven years and six months of anti-money-laundering investigation experience, confirmed by employer references.
propositions.rationale: The resume gives the dated roles and the HR verification note states the employer-checked total.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate supervised a five-person investigation pod, allocating escalated alerts daily and reviewing every closure decision before filing.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the supervision and the work sample shows the monthly quality-check log.

expectedGap: Designing training is not documented; the candidate delivered an induction using materials prepared by the compliance training team.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified CAMS credential, the employer-confirmed total of seven years and six months and the documented supervision and quality-check work; do not describe the candidate as having designed the induction.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has designed or changed any training material for investigators and how its effect was checked.
